$comment: The Flutter companion app. `node tools/init-app/apply-feature.mjs --remove mobile` (what `pnpm init-app --mobile no` runs) deletes `paths`, strips the feature:mobile blocks in `markers` and removes `jsonEntries`. Mobile has no backend seam, so `presentWhen` says how its state is read: kept while apps/mobile exists (held by apps/backend/src/architecture/optional-features.spec.ts). Its skill reference carries `requires: mobile` and is removed by the prune step, not listed here.
